name: Haena Ji
source:
"For the one who saved me... and for everyone, this time, I will change fate!"

On the morning of her birthday, a confession letter was placed in her desk drawer. After school, she headed to the location written in the letter... and that's when the mysterious incidents began. Why did this "incident" happen to us?

"I want to know about you, the one who cried for me in that final moment"
